meta.name: gstack-upgrade
meta.description:
Upgrade gstack to the latest version. Detects global vs vendored install,
runs the upgrade, and shows what's new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 gstack 工具升级到最新版并查看更新内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在使用 gstack 并希望保持它处于最新版本。
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade gstack to the latest version and see what's new.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use gstack and want to keep it up to date.

howto.what: 当检测到 gstack 有新版本时，Claude 会先询问是否升级，然后自动检测安装方式并完成升级，最后总结新版变化，并继续用户原本的任务。
howto.when: 当检测到 gstack 有可用新版本，或用户直接要求升级 gstack 时触发。

say.text: 请把 gstack 升级到最新版本
say.note: 会检测安装方式并执行升级，完成后显示更新摘要。

say.text: gstack 有新版本吗？有就升级
say.note: 有新版会先征求确认；选“稍后”则今天不再提醒。

say.text: 升级 gstack 后告诉我改了什么
say.note: 会读取更新日志，总结用户最关心的变化。

howto.what_en: When a new gstack version is detected, Claude asks for confirmation, detects the install type, runs the upgrade, summarizes what's new, and resumes the user's original task.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a gstack update is available, or when the user directly asks to upgrade gstack.

say_en.text: Please upgrade gstack to the latest version
say_en.note: Detects install type, upgrades, and shows a summary.

say_en.text: Is there a new gstack version? Upgrade if so
say_en.note: Asks first; choosing “Later” silences prompts for today.

say_en.text: Upgrade gstack and tell me what changed
say_en.note: Reads the changelog and highlights user-facing changes.
